Title: Azure Database for MariaDB is now available in the France South region

Body.Content: Azure Database for MariaDB is now generally available in the France South region. Take advantage of additional flexibility and support in deploying solutions that can help accelerate innovation with enterprise-ready, fully managed community MariaDB. For current information about the regional availability of Azure Database for MariaDB see Products available by region.
